subject: Three different friendly dinosaurs grouped in a natural habitat, all smiling triumphantly.

foreground.dinosaur_1: Apatosaurus: Three-quarter view, gentle happy smile, smooth blue-grey skin, positioned prominently.
foreground.dinosaur_2: Triceratops: Three-quarter view, cheerful smile, leathery skin, positioned beside Apatosaurus.
foreground.dinosaur_3: Ankylosaurus: Three-quarter view, brave happy smile, bone-textured armor plates, in the background looking contented.

composition.background: Open, sunny prehistoric grassland with distant volcanoes and a clear blue sky. Celebratory, light atmosphere.
composition.grouping: Dinosaurs are posed in a way that conveys happiness and success, looking out at the player.

caption_1.style: Bright red, thick 3D mixed-case block letters, positioned top-center.

caption_2.style: Shiny gold, bold 3D mixed-case block letters, positioned clearly below 'Dino Smile!', possibly with a subtle celebratory sparkle effect. Text is slightly textured, like polished gold.

visual_logic.overall_mood: Celebratory, rewarding, successful. Emphasizes the positive outcome of the game.
visual_logic.color_palette: Bright yellows, lush greens, clear blues, with the red and gold captions standing out.
